info.name: Sukrtya Siwan
info.description:
Data collection backend — master data import.

**Import Excel:** multipart field name must be `file`.

**Auth:** Collection uses **No Auth** so Postman does not send Basic headers (those cause 401 if the server expects different credentials).

**Port:** `baseUrl` defaults to **8081** (see `server.port` in `application.properties`).

formdata.description: Master roster spreadsheet (.xlsx or .xls). Re-select the file if you see a warning triangle (path moved or missing).

request.description: Uploads the Excel sheet. Expect **200** or **400** JSON — not **401** (if you still see 401, restart the app after pulling latest code and confirm **Authorization** is **No Auth** / **Inherit auth** off).
